intro: Give your hair the care it deserves with Derma Radiant Hair Serum, a lightweight and nourishing formula designed to promote healthier, stronger, and shinier hair. Infused with carefully selected ingredients, this serum helps reduce hair fall, supports healthy hair growth, and improves overall hair texture while protecting your hair from everyday damage caused by pollution, heat styling, and environmental stress.

Its non-greasy, fast-absorbing formula deeply nourishes the scalp and hair strands, helping to minimize dryness, frizz, and breakage. With regular use, your hair feels softer, smoother, and more manageable while maintaining a naturally healthy shine.
Suitable for both men and women, Derma Radiant Hair Serum is ideal for all hair types and can be easily incorporated into your daily hair care routine.

li: Helps reduce hair fall and breakage
Nourishes the scalp and hair roots
Makes hair smoother, softer, and shinier

p: Take a few drops of the serum and apply it evenly to the scalp and hair. Gently massage with your fingertips for 2–3 minutes until absorbed. For best results, use regularly as part of your daily hair care routine.
